description: This file defines the GroupServiceModel class, which models a service in the OFBiz framework, including its attributes and invocation logic.

classes.name: GroupServiceModel
classes.description: Represents a service configuration with attributes like name, mode, and execution behavior, and provides methods to invoke the service.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service model from an XML DOM element.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service model with a name and mode.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the service invocation mode (sync or async).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: resultToContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the service results should be stored in the context.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the service parameters are optional.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes the service via the dispatcher, handling sync or async modes and required parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the service model.
